description: Extends stock_alpha_v1 with output schemas for event memory and cross-sectional stock ranking.

schemas.name: Bounded Continuous Signal
schemas.description: Compresses a continuous semantic score that already incorporates direction and quality weights into a stable, bounded final signal.

terms.continuous semantic score: A continuous signed score formed by combining event, context, quality, and direction schemas.
terms.bounded: The final signal is constrained to a stable range so that extreme values do not dominate the backtest.
terms.final signal: The factor output submitted to the backtest or subsequent evaluation.

schemas.name: Event-Decay Signal
schemas.description: Retains finite memory after a valid event is triggered and gradually reduces the final signal strength over time.

terms.finite memory: The event affects the signal only within a finite observation window after it is triggered.
terms.decay: Final signal strength decreases as the event ages.
terms.event age: Time elapsed since the event was most recently triggered or confirmed.

schemas.name: Latest-Event Signal
schemas.description: When directional events alternate, retains the direction and quality of the most recent valid event and updates them within the memory window.

terms.latest event: The most recently triggered valid event after quality processing.
terms.directional event: An event whose direction has been determined by a direction schema.
terms.memory window: The finite interval over which the final signal retains the latest event's effect.

schemas.name: Persistent-Condition Signal
schemas.description: Maintains the final signal while the directional condition formed by the event, context, quality, and direction schemas remains valid; returns to a missing value or near zero when the condition expires.

terms.directional condition: An event or state condition that already carries directional meaning.
terms.persistence: The condition remains valid across adjacent bars or observation windows.
terms.condition expiry: The directional condition is no longer satisfied, or its quality is insufficient to maintain an output.

schemas.name: Cross-Sectional Rank Signal
schemas.description: At each timestamp, converts final semantic scores into cross-sectional ranks or percentiles and maps them to bounded signed signals.

terms.rank signal: A signal obtained by ranking instruments at the same timestamp.
terms.bounded and signed: The output is stably constrained to a finite signed range.

schemas.name: Cross-Sectional Z-Score Signal
schemas.description: At each timestamp, cross-sectionally demeans, standardizes, and clips final semantic scores to form a relative-strength matrix.

terms.demeaning: Subtracting the cross-sectional mean at the same timestamp.
terms.standardization: Dividing by the cross-sectional standard deviation at the same timestamp and clipping the result.

schemas.name: Smoothed Cross-Sectional Rank Signal
schemas.description: First constructs cross-sectional ranks or z-scores at each timestamp, then applies causal smoothing through time to reduce turnover.

terms.cross-sectional rank: The ranking of instruments at the same timestamp.
terms.causal smoothing: A rolling or exponentially weighted operation that uses only current and past information.

schemas.name: Cross-Sectional Event-Decay Rank Signal
schemas.description: First applies age-based causal decay to event signals within a finite window, then ranks them cross-sectionally on each trading day and maps the ranks to bounded signed signals.

terms.event decay: The event's influence decreases as it ages after being triggered.
terms.cross-sectional rank: The ranking of decayed stock signals on the same trading day.
terms.bounded output: Mapping ranking results to a stable, finite range.
